entries.title: Your panels on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: When your computer has side panels, your iPhone and iPad show them on a Panels tab, one under another in the order your computer holds them. Open it with Command-4, or from the sidebar on a wide iPad. Each panel stays up to date and its buttons work on your computer. Tap a panel's title to fold it; it stays folded next time.

picture.alt: The phone's top bar with a fourth icon, three stacked panes, lit; below it a panel titled TALLY with the word yours, its count, a 3 TASKS badge and Add one and End work buttons.
